entries.def:
βύσσος, -οῦ, ἡ (cf. Heb. בּוּץ), 
[in LXX chiefly for שֵׁשׁ, בּוּץ ;] 
byssus, a fine species of flax, also the linen made from it: Luk.16.19.†
(AS)

βωμός, -οῦ, ὁ 
(βαίνω), [in LXX (Hex.) for מִזְבֵּחַ, in Proph., chiefly for בָּמָה ;] 
__1. any raised place, a platform. 
__2. an altar: Act.17.23 (cf. θυσιαστήριον and see DB, i, 75).
† (AS)

Γαββαθα (Rec. -θᾶ), ἡ, indecl., 
Gabbatha, the Greek transliteration of an uncertain Aramaic word (DB, see word; Dalman, Words, 7), used as the equivalent of λιθόστρωτον, stone pavement: Jhn.19.13.†
(AS)

Γαβριήλ, ὁ, indecl. (Heb. גַּבְרִיאֵל, hero of God), 
the archangel Gabriel: Luk.1.19, 26.†
(AS)

γάγγραινα, -ης, ἡ, 
a gangrene, an eating sore, which leads to mortification: 2Ti.2.17.†
(AS)

Γάδ, ὁ, indecl. (Heb. גָּד), 
Gad (Gen.30.11; 49.13, al.): Rev.7.5.†
(AS)

Γαδαρηνός, -ή, -όν 
(Γαδαρά, Gadara, the capital of Peræa), 
Gadarene, of Gadara: Mat.8.28 (Rec. Γεργεσηνῶν), Mrk.5.1, Rec. (Edd., Γερασηνῶν), Luk.8.26, 37 Rec. (Edd., Γερασηνῶν).†
(AS)

γάζα, -ης, ἡ (a Persian word), 
[in LXX for גִּנְזִין, II Est.5.17; 6.1; 7.20, 21, Est.4.7 גִּזְבָּר, II Est.7.21 Isa.39.2 * ;] 
treasure: Act.8.27.†
(AS)

Γάζα -ης, ἡ (Heb. עַזָּה), 
Gaza, in OT, one of the five chief cities of the Philistines: Act.8.26.†
(AS)

γαζο-φυλάκιον, -ου, τό 
(γάζα, φυλακή), [in LXX chiefly for לִשְׁכָּה, נִשְׁכָּה (2Ki.23.11, al.), once for גְּנָזִים (Est.3.9); το͂ γ., τᾶ γ., of a temple treasury, Neh.10.37, 2Ma.3.6, al. ;] 
treasury: also, apparently, the trumpet-shaped chests into which the peoples' temple-offerings were thrown (DB, iv, 96; DCG, ii, 748): Mrk.12.41, 43 Luk.21.1, Jhn.8.20.†
(AS)
